question: Which of the following years was declared as the international year of micro credit by the UN?
solution:
The correct answer is **__2005.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **2005**, the United Nations designated it as the International Year of **Micro credit,** highlighting the significance of microfinance institutions.
 
• The emphasis was on providing financial services to low-income individuals, particularly women in developing nations, to foster economic development and empowerment.
 
• The initiative aimed to ensure access to small loans for the poor, enabling them to initiate or expand small businesses.
 
• Microloans play a crucial role** in improving family income** and **fostering community prosperity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The United Nations is an International organization founded in **1945**.
 
• It is currently made up of **193 Member states**. 
 
• UNO **Headquarter **is located in **New York, United States.**
 
• **Antonio Guterres** serving as the **Ninth Secretary-General** of the United Nations.
 
• The Main Organs of the UN are
 
 
• The UN Secretariat
 
• The General Assembly,
 
• The Security Council,
 
• The Economic and Social Council,
 
• The Trusteeship Council,
 
• The International Court of Justice, 
 
 
 
• The Five Permanent Members of the UN are- **China, France, Russian Federation, The United Kingdom, and the United States,** and
 
• Ten Non-Permanent Members elected **for Every two-year** terms by the General Assembly.
